profile.name: Steven Casimir
profile.headline: I build intelligent systems that solve real problems.
profile.summary: Network engineer, AI systems builder, product maker, and entrepreneur focused on practical systems: resilient networks, local AI, automation, observability, software products, and real-world businesses.
profile.availability: Open to high-impact engineering, AI, consulting, and build opportunities.

career.summary: Led retail network services, standards, automation, vendor coordination, and network/product initiatives across a large multi-brand restaurant environment.
highlights: Validated and supported a QU POS conversion across more than 1,800 sites.
Reduced firewall template sprawl from roughly 350–450 configurations to about 60 standardized templates.
Helped drive PCI-DSS work and held PCI-ISA certification experience.
Built and advanced NS Live, a React + Go + Azure network-services application used in a limited release.
Created Punchh password-reset automation using Azure Functions and Databricks, cutting manual handling time by roughly 80%.
Worked on Amazon Connect, T-Mobile 5G, Dialpad, network unification, and vendor integration pilots.

career.summary: Designed, standardized, supported, and automated restaurant network services and infrastructure.
highlights: Developed network standards and repeatable configuration patterns.
Worked with Meraki networking, vendor connectivity, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, and site troubleshooting.
Supported enterprise-scale restaurant technology and network rollouts.

career.summary: Network engineering role focused on observability, analysis, and operational visibility.
highlights: Worked at the intersection of network engineering and observability.
Applied analysis and operational troubleshooting to network environments.

career.role: Retail technology, customer service, and restaurant operations
career.summary: Built a practical foundation through hands-on operations, support, retail technology, and restaurant work before moving deeper into engineering and automation.
highlights: Experience includes Retail Data Systems and restaurant operations roles.
Hands-on service background continues to influence a practical, customer-focused engineering style.
